data.long_meaning: Haresh is a name of the Hindu god, Surya, who represents the sun and its power. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'hari' meaning 'shining, radiant' and 'rishabh' meaning 'strong, powerful'.

data.numerology_meaning: Haresh is a name of strong individuality and leadership. It represents new beginnings, creativity, and the ability to shine in the world.

data.cultural_impact: Haresh is a name that is rich in Indian culture and history. It is associated with the revered Hindu deity, Surya, who is the god of the sun. The name Haresh evokes images of the powerful and radiant sun, which is often depicted as a symbol of vitality, energy, and longevity in Hindu religion and mythology. The name is also reflective of the divine power and honor bestowed upon individuals with this name, positioning them as carriers of a deep cultural heritage and tradition.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Haresh holds deep spiritual significance as it is derived from the name of the Sun God, Surya. Surya is considered to be the source of all life and energy, and is revered for his ability to provide light, warmth, and health to the world. By adopting this name, individuals may be attracted to the qualities of Surya and strive to embody his qualities of strength, power, and radiance in their own lives. The name Haresh can serve as a daily reminder of the divine light and energy within each of us and inspire us to live a life filled with vitality, purpose, and spiritual growth.
